name: B10-0307/2025 (Renew) – The human cost of Russia’s war against Ukraine and the urgent need to end Russian aggression: the situation of illegally detained civilians and prisoners of war, and the continued bombing of civilians
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human cost of Russia’s war against Ukraine and the urgent need to end Russian aggression: the situation of illegally detained civilians and prisoners of war, and the continued bombing of civilians
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Russia to stop its war against Ukraine, withdraw its troops and release all detained Ukrainians. It condemns the killing and torture of Ukrainian prisoners of war and civilians, and the deportation of Ukrainian children. It asks the European Union to send Ukraine more weapons and money, to adopt a new round of sanctions against Russia, and to use frozen Russian assets to pay for Ukraine's defence and rebuilding. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament urges a new sanctions package, a fossil fuel embargo and more weapons for Ukraine.
- It affects Russia, Ukraine, and European Union governments and companies.
- Next, European Union governments decide whether to act on these requests.
